engineers: BP and Norton retained the four bottom trays and replaced the sixteen trays above the side reboiler with a 25 ft 10 in bed of No. 50 IMTP random packing. A deck distributor was selected for roughly 50 gpm/ft2. Downcomer bars were removed; the old support rings were retained. Feed preheat was restored to about 100 F average so the reboilers could strip ethane at high feed. The installed tower was rated at 92,000 b/d, held the 208 psig LPG vapour-pressure specification (about 3.5 vol% ethane), and generated about ten theoretical stages over two years of operation.
source: Deley and Graf, Oil & Gas Journal, 1 August 1994, project scope, design choices and start-up/operation sections
